name: Sunnundalu
ingredients: 3/4 cup Powdered Jaggery (Bellam) or Powdered Sugar
instructions: 1. Dry roast the whole urad dal in a heavy-bottomed pan on low-medium flame until it turns golden brown and releases a nutty aroma.
2. Allow the roasted dal to cool completely, then blend it with cardamom seeds into a fine, smooth powder.
3. Add the powdered jaggery (or sugar) to the dal powder and pulse briefly in the blender to ensure even mixing.
4. Transfer the mixture to a wide bowl, add melted warm ghee, and mix well.
5. While the mixture is still warm, take small portions and shape them into firm, round balls (ladoos).
6. Let the ladoos cool completely before storing them in an airtight container.
description: Sunnundalu is a classic, nutritious sweet from Andhra Pradesh, often prepared for children and nursing mothers due to its high protein content. It is a staple during festivals and family celebrations, known for its distinct earthy aroma and rich texture.
